subject: GATE-GREEN lowering-opus c6n-3 (04:05) for C6m: extent bound, 4x MSAA one-job passes, MRT LOAD/batch (bridge+compositor), culling, tile stats, trap fast path (inert until kernel), reorder fixes
body:
Hashes: bridge.c 4b3f8e25 .h c4abc8eb; render.c 20821822 .h 1dcb4d10; nord2_render_pass.inc 3941cbb7; compositor_submit.inc c4ced9ba; render_encoder.inc 5a4a0982; render_pipeline.inc d7b22e7c; compute_frontend.m c87bb0e0; draw_reorder.inc 75dc225f; nord2_transport.inc c30d126b; generic_batch_frontend_host_test.inc 8071e2ab; tests/nord2_metal_bridge_test.c 59ebf60f; tests/nord2_metal_render_test.c 20c14ec7; workers/render/host_test_vs_texture.py 31652acf; workers/integration_tests/inert_render_pass_test.m 323b251c (shared files contain other owners' hunks).
Gates (host only; c6n/gates.status + harness.status): iOS -Werror compute_frontend.m x3 variants + ARM64 bridge/render rc=0; render harness PASS (incl. 4x pass of 3 draws = 1 JM job chain 3; batching off -> status 5, never re-cleared); CA backboardd PF0/PF1 PASS; bridge test 18 PASS x3; render oracle PASS; run_host_tests 60 PASS up to the strict bundle link, which fails only on tegu_air_render_pipeline_variant_count/attach_source/variant_spirv (Rust exports not in the iOS archive - not mine); integration: only 'candidate provenance' (receipt vs pin 5bf6e914, not mine) + known CA stride check.
New since c6n-2: nord2_transport.inc IOConnectTrap6 path (#12): probed once per connection with STATUS; used only if the kernel sets done='N2TD' (ABI proposal on the board to KA); otherwise IOConnectCallMethod exactly as before; NORD2_METAL_TRAP=0 forces MIG. Inert on every current kernel.
Defaults that change device behaviour: NORD2_METAL_EXTENT default 1 (Mesa parity; A/B with 0); 4x MSAA pipelines/passes admitted (TEGU_DISABLE_MSAA4 restores refusal); culling admitted on the generic path. Unchanged: reorder off, MRT continuation not wired in render_encoder (awaiting encode-cpu ACK on c6n/mrt-wiring/patches.json).
ms/cmd estimates @350 MHz: #7 extent -4..-6 likely (0..-8 range; frame_bench ca200 central 31.4->22.9 GPU ms/frame), measured on device by TEGU_PERF_RT tiles=jobs/target/frag; MSAA/cull: correctness, ~0; MRT wiring (when applied, PF=1) -2..-3; reorder 0..-3 (device-dependent, 0 on frame_bench); trap -0.3..-0.5 CPU once the kernel side exists; AFBC -1..-2 not started.
Device A/B asks: NORD2_METAL_EXTENT 0/1, TEGU_DRAW_REORDER 0/1/2, with TEGU_BREAK_DETAIL/TEGU_PERF_PASS/TEGU_PERF_RT logged.
